# onenotify

> Notifications for onecheck events and your own scripts: a queue per channel, delivery to Telegram, mail and ntfy, run by cron.

## Docs

- [onenotify](https://alekzonder.github.io/onenotify): Notifications for onecheck events and your own scripts.
- [Getting started](https://alekzonder.github.io/onenotify/getting-started)
- [Configuration](https://alekzonder.github.io/onenotify/configuration)
- [Messages](https://alekzonder.github.io/onenotify/messages)
- [Sending your own messages](https://alekzonder.github.io/onenotify/sending)
- [Queue and delivery](https://alekzonder.github.io/onenotify/queue-and-delivery)
- [Output and exit codes](https://alekzonder.github.io/onenotify/output-and-exit-codes)
- [Module management](https://alekzonder.github.io/onenotify/module-management)
- [Logging and logrotate](https://alekzonder.github.io/onenotify/logging-and-logrotate)
- [Module protocol](https://alekzonder.github.io/onenotify/module-protocol)
- [Development](https://alekzonder.github.io/onenotify/development)

## Modules

- [telegram module](https://alekzonder.github.io/onenotify/modules/telegram)
- [mail module](https://alekzonder.github.io/onenotify/modules/mail)
- [ntfy module](https://alekzonder.github.io/onenotify/modules/ntfy)
